title: Filler reminders
summary: A filler reminder asks you to choose a track for an hour whose clock is short and has no filler choice, or whose filler pool is empty.

entities.text: One open question for one hour of one clock, with a deadline before air.
When the reminder closes by itself. The clock's default filler mode, or the global fallback, is then used.
The clock's filler pool has no unused tracks left. Refill the pool on the clock; choosing a track here is not possible.

usage: Answer a reminder by choosing a track for the hour. The track is checked against separation and play rules; a refused track shows why. Air never waits for an answer.
steps: Search for a track that fits the shortfall and listen to it with the play button.
mistakes: Waiting until the hour is about to start. Hours close to air are frozen and their reminders can no longer be answered.
Choosing a track that played recently. Separation refuses it.

example.title: A short evening hour
example.text: The clock "Evening" is short by 2 minutes at 20:00 tomorrow. Open the reminder, search for "interlude", listen to a 1:55 instrumental, and choose it. The 20:00 hour is rebuilt with it.

track_id.label: Track
track_id.text: The track that fills the hour's waiting segment. It must pass separation and play rules.
